description.subtitle: Adidas cotton hoodie x FARM Rio del Real Madrid - beige
description.tagline: El Real Madrid se une al estilo de FARM Rio
description.intro: The hoodie adidas Real Madrid x Farm Rio Hoodie combines the identity of the white ensemble with the creative personality of FARM Rio. Its design features a more discreet aesthetic on the front, while the back incorporates a striking floral graphic that reflects the colorful character of the collaboration. Made entirely of cotton and with a loose cut, it offers a soft, comfortable and relaxed feel for the day to day.
key_benefits: Collaboration with FARM Rio: It fuses the identity of Real Madrid with the characteristic creative style of the Brazilian firm.
Comfort: The cotton fabric provides a soft and pleasant touch.
Relaxed fit: The loose cut favors freedom of movement and a casual style.
Personality design: The floral graphic of the back brings the distinctive and colorful touch of the collaboration.
